notes.title: Stellar Log 12: Personality Core Constellation Preview
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]
Been a while since the last dev log, I just happen to finally have something to show so let's get into it!

So a little bit of a detour
I've been learning a lot from my workplace as a game developer. Been spending a lot of things to organize my database for easier tweak and balancing. Setting up tools and excels, and framework and everything. So I can easily change various values and input to the spreadsheet for the formula to update and tweak automatically with a simple button to download it back into the project.

But yeah, now let's get back to the main topic of this dev log.

[h1]Personality Core: Constellaion[/h1]

If you've played the demo before you'll see the interface teaser about this feature. So now I'm integrating constellation into the gameplay loop!
I'll have to playtest this for more feedback but for now, let's take a look at the overview!

You can unlock Personality Core Constellation through meta progression at the system expansion upgrades.

Each personality core has its unique constellation, which is basically a skill tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/c7641311a1a9b408b34f5d9a1a689b5a19bbd7a0.png[/img]

[h2]CORE PASSIVE[/h2]
At the middle of all constellations is the core passive. This is the bread and butter of the constellation and the playstyle it can provide. Not only does it provide a unique gameplay mechanic but it comes with a dedicated interface to go along with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/7c3d0b47354d845b46538eb8cab54ac532a9827d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/ceb2df4245c7a54a4901814bcbd418fe74eedf12.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/a0b03c59dd5c3477b25423553cfe07652ffa4d26.jpg[/img]

[h2]CONSTELLATION NODE[/h2]
You can unlock other nodes like any other skill tree, each constellation has different branching nodes, and each offers a different experience to accompany the core passive.
Nodes are separated into 3 tiers, the tier represents the cost needed to unlock and their power. I'm still thinking about how to balance the point. But for now, the primary method to collect node points is just simply to progress through the run. Although I'd like to be other methods for veteran players to exploit too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/94cc3e20cc4a94f690bb8d11c2e1d4245da2df1e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/5f21bd35589f1499c3e53a3b3bbf60faf417cc0f.png[/img]

[h2]CONSTELLATION OVERLAY[/h2]
Later down the line once the player unlocks harder content. Players can select an additional personality core as a support unit. This means you can combine 2 constellations into one, allowing for room to cook up some crazy synergy!

[h2]CONSTELLATION SHOWCASE[/h2]
In this section, I'll showcase Stellar Constellations and explain how her design works.
This constellation core passive revolves around the Red and Blue gauge. You can fill up those gauges by dealing and taking damage respectively. Once both gauges are full, enter Binary Mode which grants powerful effects such as a chance to double damage dealt or completely nullify damage taken. Encourage the player to try a balanced build for this one. But with some clever thinking, we can cheat the system! Build that deals a lot of small damage quickly can build the red gauge much faster, and did you know that self-damage effects also count toward the blue gauge?
Sooo.. if there is a build that focuses on dealing damage to themselves to trigger a damaging effect. We will essentially be filling both gauges at the same time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/731f85935388511e1b2e9ba3155d0b6e0a58c67e.jpg[/img]

The next major demo update, all 5 personality cores will have their constellation available. I'm slowly checking off the checklist for the stuff I've wanted to be done but for that update, we are getting close. The last few subjects I'd like to touch on are the boss fight overhaul and some more variety of content during each run. But I'll keep it small because this still just a demo either way.

Thank you for reading this far, the game is still in the work though I'd love to really find more time to put in this project. But at the very least, I'll promise that the major update will drop within this year for sure!

notes.title: Stellar Log 11: Rework Update
notes.content:
[h3]Finally got some time to show for the major rework I’m working on![/h3]
Sorry about the silence as I said in the previous update, I’ve been busy getting accustomed to my new work life.

[h1]So let's get to the menu![/h1]
Before I release this rework update, I wanted to have some significant content for player to experience even if its just a demo. Well, I think that the way to go, have the player taste all forms of content in the demo before I expand it further in full release.

These are some features I’ve been cooking and that I’d like to share!


[h2]Recap: Main Game mode, Odyssey[/h2]
I don’t remember how much I’ve explained about the new game mode but I’ll briefly introduce it again.
As players start a new run, they will be entering a big arena filled with various obstacles, interactable, events, and rewards to find. But time is essential because this big area will start to shrink smaller and become much more hostile over time.

Once players are finished with the area, they can call for the teleporter to escape to a new area and repeat the process. There will be a set limit number of areas players are able to explore before being forced to fight the final boss.

So basically the goal is to try to gather as many resources as possible and get stronger before the time up and fight the boss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/9321ede91e02f82b4f141357864ff1d2b210b946.png[/img]

[h2]Point of Interest & Hazard[/h2]
Continuing from the last dev log, a unique point of interest and hazard will be introduced to each level.
Points of interest can range from simple interactable that give you a small reward, to a full-on side quest to complete for huge payout. While hazards will be things like obstacles that randomly spawn to environmental damage or mechanics.

The main things to note are unique mechanics and global hazards that will be added to each level.

[h3]For example in the first level (Astral Ocean)[/h3]
There is a special structure called Observation Tower.
They can be scattered around the playable area. Players need to activate these towers in order and be rewarded with plentiful research points. This can be great for the early game for players to grind those points for unlocking meta progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/6bf0226deb063dc58aab17a7c31bc6870a67d190.gif[/img]

[h3]And is here some shot at the global hazard, Heart of Starlight.[/h3]
With a very rare chance of triggering, this global hazard can take place at the center of the area. Creating a gigantic magnetic storm that sucks up nearby asteroids. But if we are tough enough to venture through inside, you might find something valuable!
I hope this will bring more characteristics to each level make it less repetitive and make players excited to see what’s new when they unlock a new level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/9c916b2b703ff6e7c2e8495c2ab5ade444d5021f.gif[/img]

[h2]New Meta Progression[/h2]
I’ve added more meta progression to this new demo, which will use some of the new material that I’m implementing and will explain later.

[h3]Arkship: Absolute Aura[/h3]
The player can acquire a shard and essence of a specific Arkship to increase their Absolute Aura. These aura grant global permanent bonuses to all ally units during gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/e40a3c6a93da75423c049c85bb0d381f3d17b221.png[/img]

[h3]Starship: Attachment[/h3]
I’m reusing of the old mastery system into new ones. This system allows the player to spend “Modules” to attach offensive, defensive, or auxiliary modules to their starship of choosing. Which will provide further stat bonus to the starship. It work similarly but this one will be permanent upgrade that can unlock outside the gameplay.

[NOTE: This is old picture of mastery system]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/48649730fc5906a3c413119498277fbd34846f8c.png[/img]

[h3]Global Modification: Unique & Cheat Modification[/h3]
Expanding the global modification, The unique tab as the name suggests provides unlock for unique upgrades instead of simple stat upgrades. The cheat tab something I'm testing, it will allow players to willingly turn on difficulty challenge mode or even spend an absurd amount of research points to buy some game breaking cheats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/516d912fce6520492e3527ed5f6de5a83dc753d4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/8929834b0d2feb3607c5abe05f28213f51510d6a.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded Currency, Materials, and Resources[/h2]
Previously, the game only had research point as a main currency for unlocking new content and upgrades. But now we have modules and materials.

Module: This can be dropped by defeating the corresponding enemies. The enemy that focuses on attacking will drop the offensive module, an enemy that is more tank drop the defensive module, and an enemy that heals or buffs drop the auxiliary. This applies to everything in between.

Material: A new set of materials is being added to the game. This includes Nanomaterial, Life Thread, Synthetic Fuel, and Starlight Crystal. These materials are most often dropped from completing specific events or destroying corresponding interactable like mining depots. Players can use the material to create new stuff in the future, stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/89a5b2c56394aa0707b54c390a1ecd15d1ed9714.png[/img]



That’s about it for now, I’m eagerly awaiting to finally polish the rework update for players to try it out.
I’ll try to update the dev log more frequently if I have the time. But for now, see you later!

notes.title: Game Status Update! (Stellar Log: 10)
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings everyone to the dev log yet again![/h2]

[h3]Since the last dev log you might see that there have been fewer updates on the project overall.[/h3]

Simply put, I've just got a full-time job as a game dev for a small indie studio called BitEgg Inc.
They have quite a promising title coming, which has stacked up quite a bit of a wishlists. That is none other than "Lost and Found Co." It's been an honor and a great experience so far!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2101390/Lost_and_Found_Co/

Now that I graduated from unemployed to fully employed, the speed of progress on my game has been greatly reduced. As I've been working on the game on and off. This past month I've dealing with moving places and family members, settling into my new work life and schedule. Like an unannounced hiatus break. (Which explains the slow update)

To trace back the history of this game. It starts as a thesis project for my game design class. I wanted this game to be more than just a student project, so I pushed it forward and entered various events. Now we are here, way further than what I initially planned.
At the start, I plan to make a small game for a fast release. But now that I've got a job, there is no need to rush but all the while less time to work on it too.

[h3]So this is how the plan for this game going forward in the next year![/h3]

I will keep working on the game and fully intend to finish it. With this opportunity, I won't have to rush to release it but take my time to polish it to satisfaction. Originally this would take just a year to finish, but now going forward it would probably need a few more years. (Ideally one or two years.)

Also now that I'm not a broke college student I can put more funds into other aspects like art and sound. And hopefully, I can gain more experience from work to make my game even better!

It's going to be a long journey onward from this point. I'll be glad if you are interested in following this adventure. And fully understand the dissatisfaction with the change in direction.

I'll be back next month in the dev log like usual, and try to bring something new to show.

Stay safe and happy new year!

notes.title: Stellar Log 9: New Game Mode Odyssey!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there everyone.
Welcome to the monthly dev log![/h1]

Since the last dev log, I've been pretty quiet. I was prototyping a new game mode, which is the main topic I'd love to get into in this dev log!

So basically I've tried to look at the comments and feedback for real this time. Mainly the game already has a promising concept but the execution left much to be desired.
Instead of fixing and improving on those suggestions. I like to try a different approach and change from the foundation itself.

[h2]New Game Mode: Odyssey[/h2]
Combining the previous game mode of standard wave base with more hoard base and a mix of exploration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/2d02104ee05683fec996ff3660ebb837e376e818.gif[/img]

[b][u]TLDR: Your goal is to race against time to gather resources and become as strong as possible before fighting the final boss in the run.[/u]
[/b]
[h2]Level, Zone, and Area Explanation[/h2]
The game will have 3 different levels each with its unique traits. A level has 3 zones that the player can unlock. Each new zone provides higher difficulty and a slight variation from the last. Players can select a zone to start a run, where they must progress through multiple areas until reaching the final boss.

[h2]Basic Game Loop[/h2]
Upon entering a new area, the player will be randomly spawned around a big map. The space is filled with different events, points of interest, obstacles, and interactable.

Similar to horde survival and vampire survivor clones, there will be a timer and enemy spawn.
But every once in a while, the player will be invaded by a special encounter.
[u][i](NOTE: Unlike VS-Clone, enemies don't drop as many resources. The primary method of gathering resources is for the player to explore, interact, and complete different events and points of interest.)[/i][/u]

Once the player is done with the area, they can call for a teleporter to the next area whenever they are ready. But the cooldown will get longer each time. During the teleporter event, they must survive 30s against large horde of enemies.
[u][i](NOTE: Previously there a repeating feedback that players get to spend too little time in combat before being forced to stare at a menu. This should provide the freedom to choose their own pace and the agency on when best to escape.)[/i][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/683c2180c6c6a71408fb65f3ae4b3255978756bf.gif[/img]

[h2]New Mechanic: Clearance Stage[/h2]
The clearance stage indicates the current progress of the run. The player must reach the final clearance stage to be eligible for the final area, where they can fight the boss.
As the clearance stage progresses, a new set of enemies will spawn with increasing intensity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/910a9b5307c40b85d46941c72f2f286db83e1427.png[/img]

There are two main methods to progress the clearance stage.
Primary method: the clearance stage will progress automatically every minute. For example an easy zone with 10 clearance stages, the player can expect to fight the final boss around the 10-minute mark.

Secondary method: Simply killing an enemy and completing various events. Most of the time you can't out kill the first method. But this alternative is solely for the player who can archive their god run early, as they will be able to trivialize the game and complete the run even faster.

[h2]New Mechanic: Area Instability & Dimension Collapse[/h2]
These 2 mechanics work together to introduce a sense of creeping dread.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/75aec84b529d4a0c2a9a111a8190bbfd758b9d32.png[/img]

Area Instability acts like a timer for the area. The instability decreases at a constant rate. Various actions can influence how fast the rate decreases and some can even refill the instability.
There isn't anything to worry about until the moment the instability reaches 0, which will trigger an overtime event. Once the Overtime starts, everything will become MUCH more hostile and dangerous and the player will be forced to move to the next area.

Dimension Collapse is a new mechanic that forces the player to race against time. The collapse always triggers at a fixed interval. During the collapse, the map border will begin to shrink similar to the like of other Battle Royal games. The player must navigate to a safe space, as trying to venture into the collapsed zone will result in taking damage every second. Every time a collapse is triggered, a hazard level increases. This value affects the damage when out of bounds along and other obstacles. Most events and points of interest will be disabled outside of the safe zone, cutting players from valuable resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/2b0eeaa1d9fdc0e0abc8ebac37a431fbefed8d15.gif[/img]

[h2]New Mechanic: Event, Point of Interest, and Interactable[/h2]
There where feedback about the game being too slow and boring. Especially during the early game
Going with the basics, these should provide players with a variety of gameplay flavors and incentives to explore the area.
These are some of the examples.

[h3]Reinforcement Base[/h3]
Players can interact to engage in combat with elite troops. Once started, the player will be locked inside and must destroy all the spawned enemies. Completing the event will reward with plentiful resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/c1e3da22610b3175a01476f7f6a9c205aee549b6.gif[/img]

[h3]Captured Planet[/h3]
Destroy the corrupting shield and free the planet. Doing so will reward you with minor resource and refill some area instability. Additionally, a liberated planet will create a permanent zone that protects you from collapsed damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/1ac89fbf4b462dc5a5cc33df386e21c6d4cb737e.gif[/img]

[h3]D.R.I.L.L (Delayed Interstellar Railgun Local Launcher)[/h3]
This interactable can be interact, which will start a delay timer. Once complete, the launcher will fire the railgun to the current mouse position. Creating AOE dealing heavy damage to enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/cb23e2a6edfe375b67cb474894876fe4b43dd05c.gif[/img]

New Mechanic: Corruption Rate [WIP]
The corruption Rate is a value tide to each zones. This value is dynamic and affects various systems, chance, and mechanics that players can engage in the run.

Generally, the more a zone is corrupted the harder it becomes. When players start a run in each zone, they can perform various actions in the run to reduce the corruption of that zone. Thus, as players complete more runs for that specific zone, it will become easier over time as the corruption decreases.
But in reverse, other zones will have their corruption increase at the same time making them harder.

This provides a management aspect to the player. Giving them incentive to switch around and try out different level zones equally instead of focusing on one place. Allowing the player to strategize of the best course of action on each zone to engage and what zone to leave out.

All and all, this feature is still in design pace. It is a building stone toward the end game. Once the player has cleared all corruption. They will be able to fight the final boss of the game, Star Devourer.

But yea, that's pretty much it for now. There is minor rework going on too but not anything major. Let me know how you feel about this new game mode! I'll continue to patch things out for a bit before release a demo for this game mode.
[h1]See you soon! [/h1]

notes.title: Stellar Log 8: Development Plan
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome back to our usual monthly dev log and updates.[/h3]

The Steam Next Fest has ended and we get some new followers and tractions. Sadly there won't be much new stuff to show in this dev log. But I'll be talking a little about what's next and the future of the game!

[h2]First off![/h2]
Thank you everyone for being interested in the game, both old and new. This is my first project and I'm learning many new things.

The Next Fest event does a pretty good number but is just a little short of what I expected. Thus, there will be some change of plan. Originally the game was planned to release as an early access by the end of this year.

[h2]Adjustment In Release Date[/h2]
I've decided to take some more time to step up the game and accumulate more following. Ideally, I want to make a game presentable enough for an influencer to notice. As I've learned that is one of the most effective methods to bring your game to a larger audience. Hopefully the early access will be live by early next year.

[h2]Future Development[/h2]
During the Next Fest, I tried many demos and studied other competitors in the market. I have taken some steps back to take another look at my game and sorting priorities for improvement. This is also another reason why I'm taking a bit more time in the oven before serving.

I like to think that my game already have an idea that is interesting and set itself apart. But it does feel like its not enough and need just a little more special sauce to shine.
[list]
[*] I want the combat to feel more satisfying and engaging.
[*] I want the overall visual to fit in seamlessly and more interesting eye candy.
[*] I want the game to have better clarity so that more players can engage in depth with the mechanic.
[*] And the last one is the most simple, I just want the game to be fun in general. Whether you like the action aspect or the strategizing aspect of the game.
[/list]


The special demo for the Next Fest will be up for a few more days, and some content will be locked after that.

As always, hope everyone a great day. Feel free to follow the development right here on [url=https://x.com/BinaryStellar]X (Twitter)[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/5a2UerwP]discord![/url]

notes.title: Miscellaneous Update (Patch 0.7.2.2)
notes.content:
This update aims to fix and tweak various gameplay elements to improve player experience.

[h2]Game Juice Tweak[/h2]
-Adding directional effects based on player velocity and direction.
-Slightly reduces stamina consumption when sprinting but greatly increases stamina cost for dashing.
-Implement various hidden mechanics that provide a stamina boost. For example, changing formation when stamina is below a certain threshold, or performing multiple dash in succession.
-Improve slow motion, hit stop, camera, and screen shake.
-Implement additional audio cues and audio tweaks.

[h3]NOTE:[/h3] A better game feel doesn't hurt anyone. I feel like the game could need more of it. The highlight is the stamina boost mechanic that I've hidden through various systems in the game. This will encourage players to engage in different mechanics to pull off fast and fluid maneuvers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/38acdf81a0cc76c6ea4d6c19bf65c25b53db77b1.gif[/img]


[h2]Combat Action[/h2]
-Slightly increase the sprint speed of player Arkship.
-Slightly increase the movement speed of all enemy units.
-Slightly increase the projectile speed of all enemy attacks.
-Slightly increase health scaling of enemy units, greatly increase elite health scaling.

[h3]NOTE:[/h3] These adjustments are to make the action combat feel more fast-paced. I've increased enemy aggression to match with player mobility. This will encourage the player to move and dodge more often. And since there has been some player feedback that they haven't had enough of the combat. Thus, I made the enemy tougher, especially the elite!


[h2]System Change[/h2]
-Burst Command Powerline: From now on the powerline will provide energy in order instead of providing to all bursts in the command.
-Increase base energy distribution to 100
-Reduce distribution decay rate to 10% per burst.
-Slightly increase all unit burst energy requirements.

[h3]NOTE:[/h3] This change is hope that the player will put more bursts into a command line instead of just one burst. Providing more room to strategize while keeping the balance.


[h2]Interface Adjustment[/h2]
-Add tags to the Drive & Class Boost tooltip.
-Add attack description to Squadron Purchase Tooltip.
-Add various purchase suggestion visual cues to the squadron banner in the shop.
-Add action cursor.

[h3]NOTE:[/h3] I've added in new action cursor to keep track of various stuff and some new visual and audio cues. I hope this will make the combat experience more easy and seamless without the need to gaze your eye to different corners of the screen.


Bug Fixes
-Fixed the issue where the enemy encounter spawns too quickly even before notification.
-Fixed electrify status deals too much damage too fast.
-Fixed some text misspellings.

notes.title: Stellar Log 6: Foundation Update! (0.7.0)
notes.content:
[h1]Greeting! How is everyone doing![/h1]

Time flies when we aren't looking, and we have come a long way. With the upcoming Steam Next Fest, I wanted to catch up with everyone on the monthly log on the progress and state of the game. 

Not only that, I've brought some major foundation updates to the game that I'd like to share!

[h2]So like start with this new "Foundation Update"[/h2]
This update tweaks and overhauls various systems of the game, adding quality-of-life features and expanding upon the base, the foundation of the game. I wanted to refine and make sure the core of the game feels good to play and this update is a direct response to that.

[h3]Level Zone[/h3]
Previously players would select levels by choosing different nodes on the main menu. This is still true, each level with have its own stage characteristic and enemy design.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/6b62805c3db6a39073e964b57974afad1a679ef2.png[/img]
But now there will also be different zones to choose from for each level. Consists of easy, medium, and hard. The player has to complete each zone to unlock the next accordingly. The stage count, enemy encounters, and reward will also change depending on the difficulty. Each zone will also have its own dedicated final boss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/1f7457114e16e720e36a4783811740a7a68024c1.png[/img]

[h3]Progressive Background[/h3]
The stage background will progress along as the player completes each stage. This gives the same awe and accomplishment, as a reward for surviving this far, players will be able to see more beautiful spacescape!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/1292cbfb748c7cb1931c3cfe6c625abfb9f1ad36.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/dc58396827ea428cf1f8c01cee480dcf524744c8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/f4536459b1fdb0234f0aa9e1f8b74df78c9a0e2d.png[/img]

[h3]Rework Enemy Encounter[/h3]
The enemy encounter has been completely redesigned to make the combat phase more fun. Stage takes longer to clear, adding more enemies to fight, and trying to make each encounter unique with various enemy combinations. With more stages dedicated to introducing new enemy types. Speaking of which, let's talk about it.

[h3]New Enemy Roaster[/h3]
I have redesigned the old enemy sprite and AI while adding 5 new enemy types to the game. I want each enemy type to be more unique with different attack patterns and movement behavior. Making it more fun to strategize and come up with a plan to fight against different encounters!

[i]These are a sneak peek at some of the new enemy types.[/i]
https://x.com/BinaryStellar/status/1824784836604915849/video/1
https://x.com/BinaryStellar/status/1824785188951654873/video/1


[h3]Player Maneuver: Dash[/h3]
Finally, the fan favorite feature of any game has arrived. Players can now quick-press the sprint button to dash!

[h2]Outpost QoL Improvement[/h2]
The interface is the topic I've discussed many times and is undeniably the part that I've spent time working on the most. Each update tries to make it easy to use and more intuitive.

[h3]Stage Milestone[/h3]
During the stage clear menu, there will be a milestone at the bottom. I added this here so players can anticipate when the stage will be coming next and have time to prepare.
Additionally, players can see the remaining stage right away in the outpost menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/e6aa658404f1bc2258f2f8a0ec47e79879713f8b.png[/img]

[h3]Simplify Text & Alternate Text[/h3]
From now various texts will be simplified to only a few sentences. Players can expand the text by holding the alternate button to see detailed information. Hopefully, this can greatly reduce the clustered text and be a middle point for casual players who just want to play the game and the hardcore who want to min-max all numbers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/547c871ed9386bcbb63178efa9da04213dcd0743.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/b643635ff932bf4d0be7a30910f058f96b030ff0.png[/img]

[h3]Formation Panel Improvement[/h3]
Players can now zone in and out while editing their formation. The player can also toggle their inventory for a better look at their fleet. A little addon, the panel background is now transparent. You can now enjoy the view while customizing your team!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/6e760db91c5c0800b3a4db943a5f49b3e90d1aae.png[/img]

[h3]Artifact Extraction[/h3]
Banner resprite, now your artifact extraction will look much cooler!
I've also add a quick view button at the bottom, Now players can look at their inventory before choosing an artifact.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/34fdf96ec457f141d91d1cb65a4c7ba52be6eba6.png[/img]


And while there are still some small tweaks to point out. I think it is long enough, so let's finish off with the progress update.

[h1]State Update[/h1]
The progress is going smoothly. I might have taken some detours here and there, plus with been busy the past month with some personal subjects. But now I should be able to give full attention to the game!

[list]
[*] The Fire theme level is in development and will be in the Steam next fest demo as promised.
[*] Full controller support is being worked on, note that the game right now can be played with a controller. But there are still some areas that aren't supported.
[*] New meta progression to unlock more ships, this also means there will be some new starships and artifacts to try out in the next fest demo!
[*] Besides those, there is still some game mechanics that I'd like to add but I can't promise too much right now.
[/list]

Hope you have a great day and try out this foundation update. Be sure to look out for the Steam Next Fest Demo!


As always, feel free to follow the progress of the game through [url=https://x.com/BinaryStellar]X (Twitter)[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/5a2UerwP]discord![/url]

notes.title: Stellar Log 5: Back from the break!
notes.content:
[h1]How it's been, everyone![/h1]

So I haven't been active for a while due to personal business, but here I am as promised in the last dev log! I'll be able to continue the development of this game as usual.

Although I've been away, I still have something to share in this dev log so please stay!

I've had the opportunity to participate in the Thailand Talent Game Show 2024 at the end of this month.
It was a small event for new aspiring student game developer to show off their games. 

Ark Odyssey has won the Best of Sound Award along with various useful feedbacks.

Thus, I'd like to point out some interesting feedback that will be implemented for the next major demo update for the Steam Next Fest that coming this October!

[h3]To summarize[/h3]
Many player wants to engage with the combat more and reduce the time spend on the menu. There are still many aspects to try and bring out more potential of the formation system in terms of both strategizing and combat. While there are many systems to engage in synergizing, the lack of visual aids and unintuitive user experience results in the player not knowing what to do during the Outpost menu.

Here is a rough list of what I'm planning to change.
[list]
[*] Simplify the Mastery Stat Bonus system, as players need to spend a lot of time choosing bonus stat for multiple squadrons at the end of each stage. Now each squadron will automatically receive bonus stat for each mastery level depending on their classification.
(Eg. Fighter = Attack Speed / Frigate = Damage Dealt)
[*] Make Burst Chain ability available right away without the need to level up each squadron's mastery level.
[*] Redesign various enemy encounters to make it more unique and longer.
[*] Implement a dynamic background, more detail, and effects as the player progresses further in each stage.
[*] Add more player agency during combat with various stage-specific events.
[*] Minor shop overhaul to make it important and worth upgrading shop level.
[*] Implement more interface helpers to guide players in making easier and faster decisions.
(Eg. Better Tooltip / Suggestion Interface)
[*] This has already been the original place, I'll implement more unlock features like something in Brotato. Reduce the unit and artifact option at the start to prevent information overload while adding more choice as the player unlocks more meta progression.
[*] Revisit the current unit roaster (30 Starship) and make sure each has a unique identity.
[/list]

These are some of the changes I'm making, there is still a lot of the game to be improved. 
And feedback from you is the most important and greatly appreciated!

I will go back to focus on refining the basic as much as possible, this may reduce the amount of new content but its worth for a good foundation.

There will still be new updates for some small changes and bug fixes.
But if you are interested in major updates, then please check out the game during Steam Next Fest which is coming soon!

Again feel free to follow the progress of the game through [url=https://x.com/BinaryStellar]X (Twitter)[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/5a2UerwP]discord![/url]

notes.title: Stellar Log 4: Plan for Milestone
notes.content:
This game has come a long way, including the recent renaming and brand new key art and trailer.
I wanted to say again that I'm very grateful for such an opportunity and surrounded by good friends and acquaintances.

[h3]So let's get into this monthly dev log![/h3]

As said earlier, this game has been renamed from Ark of The Kosmoz to Ark Odyssey, mainly due to the difficulty in spelling when introduced to new people. So getting a new name is the most obvious thing to do.

Ark Odyssey seems like a good name because we are still keeping the Ark while Odyssey seems like a good word to pair with it.

So as of the event, I'd like to mark this as a first milestone in the journey of making this game!

Now the next milestone would be featuring the game in the Steam next fest coming this October.

This is not going to be on a scale of roadmap or anything. Still, I'd like to list of things that I'd like to put in the next fest demo. 

[list]
[*] Level zone variant, unlocking new zones with increasing difficulty.
[*] New fire theme level, something like Plasma Star, an enemy that deals thermal damage.
[*] More in-depth enemy design for both new and old levels.
[*] Some hazards events that affect both allies and enemies.
[*] New starships and artifacts with interesting synergy.
[*] Chaos system that adds more randomness to each stage.
[*] And finally, a controller support.
[/list]

After saying all that, due to personal reasons. I'll be busy for the next 2 weeks or so. Thus, the progress would slow down and there won't be new updates for a while unless some bug fix patches. 

But after that, we will be back in full force, so expect massive new content for the next demo on the steam fest!

notes.title: Stellar Log 3: Big things coming
notes.content:
Welcome back to the monthly devs log! 
A lot happened these past weeks that I like to cover.

First off, the alpha demo is out and available! Which is a big achievement for me. While the game is pretty much unknown right now. We did get some players trying out the demo during the previous Steam event. Gain some traction and feedback, which is good.
So try out the demo if you haven't yet!

Regarding feedback and demo, a new demo update should be out soon which will rework the entire interface!
 
[h1]Reworked Interface[/h1]
[previewyoutube=Nk2pgNX1qDc;full][/previewyoutube]

The interface is one aspect of the game that goes through change the most and I feel this is the best one yet. I'm eager for your feedback on the new UX/UI!

[h3]Now for something big.[/h3]
Ark of the Kosmoz will be doing a minor rebranding! Which will be renaming the game into *** ******* (Stay tuned for the reveal!) I also got some help from an artist and an editor in making a brand new key art and trailer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/91913dc823da41f93b3e314db2861031ac398b50.png[/img]
[i](Small teaser of new key art!)[/i]

[h2]And the real big thing.[/h2]

[h1]Personality Core System[/h1]
While still in the designing phase, this will be another major mechanic of the game. Thus, I'd like to put it out early to get some comments and feedback.
This system can be unlocked from meta progression. Which will allow each Arkship to manifest a humanoid assistant to help in each mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/9bf1a300862a800993a2c93fbedb5621626f93fe.png[/img]
[i](WIP preview personality core, Stellar)[/i]

The player will have main PC (Personality Core) from the Arkship they select and they can also select another PC from another Arkship as a support.

During combat, PC can activate their special ability on certain burst chains and will go into cooldown.
These special abilities can range from providing buffs to ally units to damaging abilities.

(NOTE: You will also be able to see the PC portrait during the activation.)

[h1]Personality Core Constellation[/h1]
This is another meta progression system that you can unlock after Personality Core. Which will allow the player to upgrade their main personality core constellation each run. Similar to skill-tree, PC constellation contains 3 different paths. At the end of each stage, the player will receive 1 skill point to put into the constellation.

Both Personality Core and Constellation systems aim to provide another form of progression mid-run that is more customizable and allows the player to shape their run without depending on luck.
[b](And an excuse for me to put an anime girl in the game...)
[/b]
Things are going up and I love to keep this momentum going. All feedback and suggestions are appreciated as always. 
See you again in the next update!

notes.title: Ark of The Kosmoz Alpha Demo Available!
notes.content:
Take a bit longer than expected, but we finally reached our very first milestone!


The demo is available for all to play!
I thought of using a Steam playtest feature but it probably doesn't seem different than doing a demo right away. Still, it should be noted that this demo version is still early in development and it is expected to find various bugs and issues!

And with that, I hope everyone interested enjoys their time with the demo and PLEASE don't hold back and share all the feedback and suggestions! A heavily critic or negative comment is often more useful than normal praise. Don't worry, I won't get dishearten!

Now let's briefly go over the content of the new demo.

[h3][list]
[*] 1 Playable level with 20 stages
[*] 5 Starting Arkship with unique artifact and loadout
[*] 23 Unique Starship
[*] 6 Different enemy type, 4 Elite and 1 Boss
[*] 40 Unique Artifact
[*] 2 Meta Progression system
[/list][/h3]


[list]
[h2][*]NEW SYSTEM: Mastery Rank[/h2]
Inspired by other RTS games (Especially Supreme Commander veterancy system) where units can gain experience from combat and level up to increase their stats.
Mastery system aims to introduce more in-game progression for players to manage. Your squadron will gain mastery points from various actions of each unit in the squadron. Such as dealing or taking damage. At the end phase, each squadron that collects enough points can rank up and randomly such bonus stat which will apply to all units in the squadron. Not only that, but now mastery rank is essential to unlock the full potential of a starship. They will unlock a burst chain bonus depending on their mastery rank!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/48649730fc5906a3c413119498277fbd34846f8c.png[/img]

[h3]Another dev log will be coming at the end of this month per usual. For a little spoiler, a system called "Personality Core" is being developed!
[/h3]


[url=https://twitter.com/BinaryStellar]Check out on X (platform formerly known as Twitter) where I post stuff once in a while.[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/yY84rrV3]As also discord server, I never manage a discord server myself but I hope we can build a community together![/url]

PS. This was just some random idea years ago, but with the help of Game Jam, I was able to jump-start the idea. Bring this idea into a real project for my university graduate thesis. A journey of making game from start to finish. Since rough concept to shipping. So yeah, I'll keep working on this and make sure it is released!

notes.title: Stellar Log 1: Arks Awakening
notes.content:
TLDR of the part below: I’m grateful for this opportunity and let’s make this game great together!

[h3][b]Greetings[/b][/h3] Before we get into the log. I’m grateful to be here and appreciate everyone's help. From my family and friends who support me, many other testers who participated in previous playtesting, and from now on you who are interested in my game! Let us shape this game into the best version we want it to be!
As of writing, I’m currently still a University student and this is my first commercial game. I aim to document the process of making a game from start to finish. Since the birth of the idea til post-launch support and more.

[h2][b]What’s the Hook & Anchor?[/b][/h2]
First of all, let us talk about this game and what it is.
This game is heavily inspired by great games such as SNRK, Nova Drift, Brotato, and Vampire Survivor. It's a genre blend of arcade shooter and auto battler with a little mix of RTS, put together into a wave format. 
([b]NOTE:[/b] [i]This game was originally designed to be more survivor-like but changed into stage progression like other auto battlers instead.[/i])

The hook in this game is the feature to customize your fleet by deploying various squadrons of starships, and the ability to command your starships to dynamically change formation mid-combat & focus fire with unique active skills.

[h3]Formation Customization[/h3]
While at the Outpost, you will be able to customize your fleet into 3 different formation preset. You can then cycle different formations mid-combat. Each formation has pros and cons. So utilize each formation carefully when engaging enemies in different encounters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/a7ff5ef744fcbab7c2f95491d20695fc833a5f66.gif[/img]

[h3]Special Ability (Drive Burst)[/h3]
Borrowing from the big auto battler games like TFT and Underlord is the ability system. Where units gain mana from doing actions and use their ability when mana is full.
We also have something similar, but instead of a unit use the skill automatically. You must command your units to do so manually! This tweak is to give a feeling of being a tactician on the battlefield. You can even chain abilities in orders, granting abilities in higher chains more power!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/d2ca1e632a694bf0f45a886e1e7b79f57f8098f0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/c37723a0326f83863ef8625f0709ef2b0446658a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765703/63374a5e67a59932978e476f21f5716658bb5256.gif[/img]

The game can get complicated in the beginning due to the horizontal deep of various mechanics. People who come from a casual game and expect a chill vampire survivor and normal auto battler might have a harder time adjusting.
[b](NOTE:[/b] [i]This problem should be issued in the meta progression update, as some mechanics are intended to be locked behind meta progression to prevent information overload.[/i])

This devlog aims to introduce the game in preparation for the demo that is coming on April 21!
Please come back and check out the demo later!
I’ll try to put out a devlog every end of the month or when there is a special occasion like this one!
Follower me on [url=https://twitter.com/BinaryStellar]X (Platform formerly known as Twitter)[/url] for sneak peeks and extra details about the game!
(There is also a [url=https://discord.gg/8xSBbdEu]discord server[/url] but it's pretty much empty right now.)
Thank you all again very much, feel free to let me know about anything that needs improvement. I very much want to hear all the feedback!
